result:
I wrote the delivery report for `greeting-release` to `.feature-flow/greeting-release/delivery.md`. It stays in the run's folder because the manifest sets no permanent location for reports.

The run was already finished, on the full tier, and had no earlier delivery report, so nothing stopped it or needed overwriting.

| Section | Source | Contents |
|---|---|---|
| Release notes | spec acceptance criteria AC1 and AC2 (both met) | The new `--greeting` flag and the new `users.locale` column. The manifest has no `artifacts.decision`, so there is no "why" section. |
| Deployment checklist | Generic steps based on the plan having a migration and two verify commands | Run off-peak, back up the database, apply migration `003_add_locale.sql`, deploy `src/cli.js`, run the validation checks, roll back if they fail. It doesn't describe your actual infrastructure. |
| Rollback checklist | plan.md "Rollback plan", one line per task | Task 1: `git checkout -- src/cli.js`. Task 2: `DROP COLUMN locale` and remove the migration file. Every migration step has an undo, so nothing is flagged as irreversible. |
| Migration notes | plan.md Task 2 and the risk table | Migration `003_add_locale.sql` may lock the `users` table if it's large, so run it off-peak. It is undone by dropping the column, which also deletes any locale values saved after the deploy. |
| Known issues | verify.md "Limitations" section, copied as written | Existing users get `locale = 'en'`, with no backfill from their settings. |
| Release validation steps | verify.md "Commands run" | `node src/cli.js --greeting hi` should exit 0 and print `hi`. The migration command should exit 0, and after deploy you should confirm the `locale` column exists. |

Two things in the source files to check before you ship:
- **Different databases:** the rollback command targets `app.db`, but verify ran the migration against `test.db`. Check that `app.db` is the database you deploy to.
- **SQLite version:** the rollback needs SQLite 3.35 or later, because older versions don't support `DROP COLUMN`.

The manifest now marks delivery complete, points `artifacts.delivery` at the new file, and has a new `updatedAt`. `currentPhase` is still `"done"`.
